Text_en:
Me
Abbas Naeem Abis from Diwaniyah Governorate 
I pledge allegiance to the Commander of the Faithful, Ali Ibn Abi Talib al-Qurashi, the Hashemite Kingdom, my prince, my leader, my master, my master, and all his masters. 
A Muslim, I pledge allegiance to him, and for him is my redemption. I pledge allegiance to Imam Muhammad al-Mahdi as a leader for me and for you. Every Muslim, and my soul is his for redemption. O Lord, make me one of his supporters for the sake of Muhammad and his family. #Eid_Al-Ghadeer
